review.mathCheck: Conservation of water gives \((5/6)x=(3/4)y\), hence \(x/y=(3/4)/(5/6)=9/10\). Since this is below 1, the first container is smaller and the requested ratio is 9/10, choice D.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful adaptation of official solution 1 on page 2. The candidate independently explains the shared water volume and explicitly verifies which container is smaller.
